data.narrative:
Cailabs is a Series C-stage space & aerospace company that has raised €57M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, with particular focus on 3 same-sector, same-stage companies: Sierra Space ($8.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B), and Skyryse ($1.1B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the €57M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $97M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage comparables produces a $1.5B implied valuation, though with material dispersion: the peer range spans $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 26.4x across 6 tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of Cailabs' revenue disclosure, common for private companies at this stage.

The triangulated range is $82M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $798M. This wide band reflects genuine uncertainty: stage-progression suggests a substantially lower valuation, while peer median anchors closer to $1.5B. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and trajectory (which would enable public-comp validation), the comparability of Sierra Space's $8B outlier, and whether Cailabs' specific technology and market position justify valuation at the upper or lower end of peer range.
